title: Platform Reliability / Recovery Qualification
verdictScope: Independent review of 6f903c273eedc135123e3a7968d3c00887e8cc70. Successful native workloads on the installed 8c82212 qualification build remain credited. G09 FAIL (C-02 startup admission); G08/G15/G16 BLOCKED (missing native preconditions/VoiceOver); G17 BLOCKED. No merge or M1 authorization.

target.machine: Apple M5 Pro, built-in Retina panel only

tests: Recorded native build/tests.txt: Rust 156 passed / 0 failed; application TypeScript 33 passed. Separate Claude engine-kit suite: 33 passed and 11 mutation checks. Independent review did not rerun macOS or Rust execution.

G03.scope: 1,000 typed round trips; 27/27 mixed positive, negative and boundary cases, not 27 negative cases.

G04.scope: 10,000 committed/applied patches over 59,996 ms and final projection equality; 14 recovery-case assertion sets pass. Actual pending-request overlap is not established by request-then-reload and remains G15 work. C-04 finite-run shell risk accepted under D-0006, mandatory M1 exit.

G06.scope: Ten native notification interactions plus one verified stopped-observation-to-enable handoff. Persisted-enabled unsupervised startup is a separate G09 defect, not qualified by these interactions.

G07.notRun: Codex live detached-hook ancestry in both embedded/shared-daemon modes and live observer handshake: NOT_RUN, deferred to M6 by accepted D-0004. No daemon answered M0C.
G07.scope: Accepted revised M0C mechanism and read-only provider-probe scope under D-0004/D-0005. Supervision admission correctness is tracked at G09.

G08.blocked: C-08 full Terminal.app restart: native BLOCKED/not executed here; formally deferred to isolated M15 qualification by D-0006. This does not close H-10.
G08.requiredRemediation: H-10: establish native fullscreen/Spaces entry and exit, and actual target-close/route overlap; repair permissive harness predicates and rerun these disposable cases.

G09.requiredRemediation: C-02 reopened: persisted observation_enabled is admitted at startup even on a recognized unsupervised LaunchServices instance. Require positive login-item ownership/service authorization at startup and enable; retain control-only notification handling and verify handoff, disabled/unavailable service and crash/notification race natively.
G09.scope: The six recorded UI-independence/companion-relaunch scenarios succeeded; they do not test or close the persisted-enabled startup bypass. Exclusive writer locking remains intact.

G10.scope: 57,799 acknowledged receipts rechecked with zero missing across five live process-crash rounds; total may include post-relaunch admissions. Separate deterministic commit/ACK crash suite supplies boundary proof. No power-loss claim.

G12.scope: Five harness sleepnow commands matched five Software Sleep/RTC cycles: 71 seconds by OS timestamps each, OS wakes one second after schedule. Companion wakes 1.239–1.286 seconds after schedule. OS reason contains rtc/HID Activity; no idle or multi-touch/manual wake sequence in the accepted run.

G15.scope: 906.054 seconds packaged graphics; 111/123 live canvas pairs exceed threshold and all 123 differ; all nine sampled minute checks (minutes 7–15) match the journal. Normal hide/rebuild, injected loss and reload/recreation evidence stands.
G15.requiredRemediation: H-11: native hide happened 544 ms after renderer initialization; no outstanding resource witness exists at reload. Add targeted real-init and owned-request pending barriers, native retirement, release and safe late-result/disposal/pixel assertions. Preserve native/GPU versus synthetic/injected labels.

G16.manualExternalRequired: C-09 physical external-monitor unplug/reconnect: MANUAL_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED/not executed; formally deferred to M15 hardware qualification by D-0006. This does not close H-12.
G16.scope: Native window, DPR/drawing-buffer, keyboard, AX labels and Reduce Motion checks pass on the built-in display. AX inspection is not actual VoiceOver operation.
G16.requiredRemediation: H-12: automated native VoiceOver activation, cursor navigation to labelled controls, safe activation and navigation after a window transition; restore prior system state.

G17.scope: M0C REMEDIATION REQUIRED; DO NOT MERGE; do not start M1. Resolve C-02 and H-10/H-11/H-12, record affected native regressions on the repaired exact build, then obtain independent review.

providerSemantics.claude: D-0005 ACCEPTED: acceptedInputProvenance=true; automaticHumanFollowupResolution=false/NOT_SUPPORTED. Native SDK/task-notification origins and successful main/child outcomes; composer/bridge declaration/kit proof, interactive input and native Mark handled M2. Reload authority remains conservative. Evidence: evidence/M0C/provider/claude/ and docs/compatibility/claude-observer-2.1.291.json.
providerSemantics.codex: D-0004 ACCEPTED: runtime/schema probe qualified; live hook ancestry and absent live-daemon handshake NOT_RUN, M6. Installed CLI 0.160.0 cited-source equivalence is not certification of daemon 0.159.3. Evidence: evidence/M0C/codex/.

risks: C-04: one retired native shell per recovery; 18 to 28 across ten repeated recoveries; reproduction note reports about 33 KB/recovery and bounded WebContent. Lifetime shell count is not bounded. D-0006 accepts this only with mandatory M1 exit closure: nativeWindowShells.after == nativeWindowShells.before after destruction/quiescence, stable content/cache resources and preserved recovery invariants.
C-07 worker layout order changes after a view re-subscribes (M1 office layout)
